[[File:Blue dragon icon.png|left]]
'''Blue dragons''' are the second weakest of the [[chromatic dragons]] but are still fairly powerful magic-class monsters. They primarily attack with [[magic]], by shooting a [[Fire Bolt]] spell at the player, as well as both close-range and long-distance dragon breath. [[Dragonfire#Protection|Protection against dragonfire]] is advisable, as they can hit well over 1,000 with their breath otherwise ([[Resonance]] does work against their breath). They also use [[melee]] if the player is standing next to them. They are a very popular monster to kill because the [[blue dragonhide]] and [[dragon bone]]s that they drop may be sold for a combined value of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Blue dragonhide}}+{{GEP|Dragon bones}}|c}}. Blue dragons do ''not'' drop the [[draconic visage]].

==Strategy==
As with all dragons, protection from their [[dragonfire]] is required. The following can be combined to provide full dragonfire protection:
* An [[anti-dragon shield]] or [[dragonfire shield]] (Melee), [[dragonfire deflector|deflector]] (Ranged), [[dragonfire ward|ward]] (Magic), or [[Dragonfire shroud|shroud]] (Necromancy) with an [[antifire]] potion
* An anti-dragon equipment with the [[Protect from Magic]] prayer or [[Deflect Magic]] curse
* Protect from/Deflect Magic and antifire potion

Alternatively, a [[super antifire]] potion provides complete immunity to dragonfire.

The dragons are weakest to bolts, so Ranged is the most effective style. Melee is not recommended without at least level 70 combat stats and a tier 70 or greater weapon. If melee is preferred, a combat potion such as a [[super warmaster's potion]] may be necessary to maintain accuracy.

Blue dragons in the [[Wilderness]] north of [[Goblin Village]] are a great source of Ranged or Defence training for [[free-to-play]] players. With the [[Bandos's remains]] nearby, players can indefinitely maintain Protect from Magic to defend against their dragonfire attack to free up both hands for dual-wielded or 2H weapons. Tier 50 weapons are recommended ([[rune 2h crossbow]] or [[rune crossbow]] with [[Emerald bolts|emerald]], [[Ruby bolts|ruby]], [[Diamond bolts|diamond]], or [[rune bolts]]) with [[Green dragonhide armour|green]] or [[blue dragonhide armour]], or even [[carapace armour]]. With [[magic notepaper]] and enough food, players can remain fighting them nearly indefinitely. They occasionally drop lobsters which can supplement players' own food.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Ranged ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Magic ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Melee ('strong'): 45 → 50

*{{UL|type=update|update=Update:New Foundations & DXP! - This Week In RuneScape|date=13 February 2023}}
** Moved the blue dragons from the area north of the Lumber Yard to west of the [[Black Knights' Fortress]] with the release of [[Fort Forinthry]].

*{{UL|type=update|update=Wilderness Reborn & New Quest - This Week In RuneScape|date=1 August 2022}}
** 8 blue dragons were removed from an area north of the Forgotten Cemetery. Instead, 13 new blue dragons were added north of [[Lumber Yard]].

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=This Week In RuneScape - 26/10/20#Patch Notes|date=26 October 2020}}
** Monsters with multiple variants will now consistently spawn as those variants when newly placed in the [[Sunken Pyramid|Personal Slayer Dungeon]].
*** This includes blue dragons

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch Notes (9 October 2017)|date=9 October 2017}}
** Blue dragons have been added to the [[Wilderness]] north of the [[Forgotten Cemetery]] to provide a source of [[blue dragonhide|blue dragon hide]] for free players.
** Blue dragons now drop [[lobster]] instead of [[bass]] in free to play worlds.

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch Notes (25 April 2016)|date=25 April 2016}}
** Improved respawn rates for Blue Dragons.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Love_Story|date=5 July 2010}}
** Graphical overhaul to chromatics, including baby variants.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 September 2009)|date=9 September 2009}}
** Improved various dragons’ fire-breath code behaviour to match the [[KBD]]'s existing behaviour. The actual animation has not changed.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Demons, Dragons and Giants|date=29 August 2006}}
** Graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002)|date=27 February 2002}}
** Added to game.
}}
